The '''Junkfort Station cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|drinking establishment]] located aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]].<ref name="PowerGem">"[[The Power Gem]]"</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The official name of the cantina was omitted when "[[The Power Gem]]" was reprinted in ''[[Classic Star Wars 12]]''<ref name="CSW12">[[Classic Star Wars 12|''Classic Star Wars'' 12]]</ref> and in later compilations including that [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story.<ref name="CSWVol2">''[[Classic Star Wars Volume 2: The Rebel Storm]]''</ref><ref name="EpicCollection">''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: The Newspaper Strips Vol. 2]]''</ref>
